title: The Weyl Law Meets Large-Scale Regularity on Ricci Shrinkers
summary: We prove that the weighted Laplacian, or equivalently its conjugate Schrödinger operator, on every complete gradient Ricci shrinker satisfies the classical Weyl law. The main difficulty is that uniform bounded geometry is not known for general Ricci shrinkers. To overcome this, we establish a large-scale regularity property for complete gradient Ricci shrinkers and apply it to the spectral asymptotics of the weighted Laplacian.
